scope: Complete final direct assignments to the two Confederate army posts; local contingents included. Frozen trace inspection, no new simulation. Dates derive from model day0 5March1861; these are model journeys, not historical claims.

delayCauses: [I] Raising and original muster day belong to the notice or the governor call and compliance, as retained in each lot service record.
[I] Transfer waits for the source to command actual troops, the receiving command to be known, doctrine eligibility and attention; earlier source troops may already have been sent to Charleston.
[I] Sender response actual/declared rungs, willingness terms and conditions are retained, not treated as transport time.
[I] Journey takes the actual edge lengths, capacity and permission rule. A begun leg finishes; no historical arrival is imposed.
